title: Bundled entries are terminal for the ask loop
context: A reporter without gh, without login, or without access to a private repo would otherwise be asked every session about the same entries. Re-asking a batch that cannot land under the reporter identity nags without benefit.
decision: When submit falls through to a bundle for an entry, that entry is marked bundled (terminal for the ask loop). rcf feedback list default (pending) hides bundled entries; the SessionStart hook does not count them; the Stop hook does not re-ask. rcf feedback submit <id> re-attempts one entry by hand once access exists.
consequences: The operator is never nagged about the same finding. The outbox file and the printed one-line URL are what the operator uses to relay or paste the bundle. A future access change is a hand-driven re-submit, not an automatic retry.

alternativesConsidered.name: Re-ask every session until submitted
alternativesConsidered.summary: Keep bundled entries pending so the next session asks again.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: Nags an operator who has no path to access; a hand-driven re-submit is the correct fix.
